question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

I have never seen so beautiful a landscape than this one.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**than**" instead of "**as**."
 
• The correct comparative structure to use here is "**as...as**" for positive comparisons.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**so beautiful a landscape as this one**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I have never seen so beautiful a landscape **as this one**.*
